metadata.description:
Thanks for being one of our first 25 FloriNouns minters! We appreciate your early support! Look for a poap.fun raffle once all 25 have been claimed and you could win a FloriNouns merch pack as a special thank you! Plus you'll be able to claim our ⌐◨-◨ sticker pack, available to all holders through May 31. Details to come via Twitter @FloriNouns!

And so much more fun to come! We love our holders and will continue to provide fun and !vibes! Thanks again for your early support of the FloriNouns project from @profwerder and her students!

⌐◨-◨ This POAP features FloriNouns 151 with a flamingo head, teal body, teal glasses, hoodie strings and mint accessory. FloriNouns launched on May 10, 2022.
metadata.name: You were one of the first 25 minters of FloriNouns!⌐◨-◨
